name: Local EfficientNet-B0 trained on SD-Turbo fakes vs Hemg reals
source_url: local training: experiments/train_detector.py --augment-degradation on experiments/gen_sdturbo_corpus.py output (280 SD-Turbo fakes) + Hemg/deepfake-and-real-images real class
limitations: Checkpoint is not committed; reproduce with experiments/gen_sdturbo_corpus.py + train_detector.py.
Single-generator training (SD-Turbo 4-step) — measured cross-generator transfer: DALL-E AUROC 0.99 / recall 0.75 / FPR 0.00 (4 samples, small set).
In-domain holdout AUROC 0.999 / recall 1.00 / FPR 0.075 (80 held-out).

Measured failure: face-manipulation fakes (Hemg 'fake' class, StyleGAN/faceswap-style 256px portraits) score as real — AUROC 0.44, recall 0.00. That class is covered by the sbi-effnet member (crop_faces); do not treat a low score here as evidence of authenticity.
JPEG q50 recompression collapses fake scores toward 0 (measured: recall 0.00 on q50 Hemg) — compressed media reads low regardless.
Scores are a prioritization signal, not a truth label.
notes: Model logits are (real=0, ai=1); score_index 1 with softmax yields the fake probability on a 0-100 scale.
ensemble_weight 0.6 keeps it advisory until a larger cross-generator corpus validates the DALL-E transfer signal.
